401-2530-3944-4699.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-4699.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7841-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

1719-2645-3430-5873.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1719-2645-3430-5873.description:
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Everglades
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3875-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3875-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

4613-4968-8036.description:
Activate Christine Chapel by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Christine Chapel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

348-1152-4867-5075-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-4867-5075-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and Ogre Slumlord triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2511-4550-5567-7824--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2511-4550-5567-7824--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6141.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6141.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Displacer Beast from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Displacer Beast enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Displacer Beast that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Displacer Beast token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first Displacer Beast token trigger, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the second Displacer Beast token trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice the nontoken Displacer Beast.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Displacer Beast that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Displacer Beast token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first Displacer Beast token trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 2.

1368-3480-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3480-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1020-2034-2866-7646.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Krallenhorde Howler.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Krallenhorde Howler.
Repeat.

1144-2645-3430-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya, and adding another {G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

911-5147-6972--112.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
911-5147-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

38-640-2173-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

6797-6872--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
6797-6872--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3020-3967-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
3020-3967-6701.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it triggers, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature returned in step 4.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1365-1651-6701-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-6701-6797.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1251-3259-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1251-3259-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

3918-3941-4222.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

5334-5657-5705.notablePrerequisites: You have a colorless Eldrazi card in hand with the mana to cast it.
5334-5657-5705.description:
Cast any colorless Eldrazi spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek twice and Glaring Fleshraker's first ability twice.
Resolve a Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the colorless spell, the remaining Ulalek trigger and both Glaring Fleshraker triggers.
Resolve the first Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 2.
5334-5657-5705.notes: This combo creates an infinite amount of copies of the cast Eldrazi spell on the stack.

2061-2103-4823.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
2061-2103-4823.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4131-5487-5647.description:
Cast Molten Duplication by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Roxanne's second ability triggers, adding {C}.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

152-1270-2034-5446.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating three token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating 18 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing four Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

358-1368-4098-5115.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
358-1368-4098-5115.description:
Cast Infernal Plunge for its escape cost by paying {R}, exling three other cards from your graveyard, and sacrificing Stiticher's Supplier.
When Stitcher's Supplier dies, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve Infernal Plunge, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {B}.
Cast Stitcher's Supplier for its escape cost by paying {B} and exling three other cards from your graveyard.
When Stitcher's Supplier enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

3156-3661-4336-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
3156-3661-4336-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, targeting Shield Sphere.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Shield Sphere.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Shield Sphere, targeting Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Shield Sphere dies, Koll triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

341-3260-3540-4740.notablePrerequisites:
"Enchantment" chosen with Umori.
Your life total is at least nine if your storm count is equal to zero, at least six if your storm count is equal to one, at least four if your storm count is equal to two, or at least three otherwise.
341-3260-3540-4740.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life, targeting K'rrik.
Aetherflux Reservoir and K'rrik trigger.
Resolve the K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain an amount of life equal to your storm count.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to K'rrik.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may use Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

1183-1385-3097-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Dean of the Root.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1183-1385-3097-4659.description:
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {C}{C}.
The Pentavite dies, triggering Zulaport Cutthroat, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

654-2893-3688-4500.notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
654-2893-3688-4500.description:
Activate Fertilid, searching your library for a basic Forest card, putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Retreat to Kazandu triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter Fertilid.
Tap the land for {G}{G}.
Repeat.
